description.text: An expansion pack of the Pokémon Card Game series, released on 15 October 2004, bringing back Team Rocket seven years after the original Rocket Gang. It is full of Team Rocket's Pokémon, among them Pokémon ex such as Rocket's Mewtwo ex, together with Dark Pokémon and Team Rocket Trainers. Its Star cards are Treecko, Torchic and Mudkip. The cards are numbered to 84, with Here Comes Team Rocket! as a secret card beyond that. In English it became EX Team Rocket Returns in November 2004.
